author: Inside Edition
description: We're hearing from one of the owners of the Brooklyn store where singer Kelly Clarkson says she was talked down to after asking about a $15,000 mechanical bird. Storeowner Adam Rubin says Clarkson's social media attack is putting his staff in danger. Rubin says he was not supposed to be at his shop Tuesday because he is recovering from skin cancer but says he had to respond to what he calls Clarkson's social media warfare. Clarkson did not respond to Inside Edition's request for comment.
title: Brooklyn Boutique Owner Says Kelly Clarkson's Posts Put His Staff In Danger

author: Inside Edition
description: Reality TV mom Kate Gosselin is finding herself in an uncomfortable situation. The former star of "Kate Plus Eight" is being criticized in a new book by one of her children. Collin Gosselin's memoir, “In the Shadow of Eight: Surviving the Reality of My Childhood," alleges she was a bad mother. Now, people on the internet are also criticizing Kate's parenting choices. In the past, Kate has denied Collin's allegations of abuse, calling them complete fabrications.
title: In New Book, Kate Gosselin’s Son Collin Says She Was A Bad Mom

author: Inside Edition
description: Selma Blair was in tears as she appeared before a judge just hours after she allegedly assaulted crew members during a flight. The actress allegedly assaulted two flight attendants and tried to open a cabin door. Her attorney tried to dry her tears in court. Blair pleaded not guilty to two counts of second-degree assault, and was released on $20,000 bail. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has the latest.
title: A Crying Selma Blair Appears Before Judge After Alleged Mid-Air Assault

author: Inside Edition
description: French authorities announced the recovery of two purloined Renoir paintings, found behind a wall in Marseilles.
title: Crime Scene DNA Leads To Stolen Renoirs #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump's new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, made her White House debut Tuesday with an announcement that Donald Trump Jr's former fiancée, Kimberly Guilfoyle, has been asked to resign as the U.S. ambassador to Greece. Trump donor Eric Deters shared text messages he said were from Guilfoyle, asking him to pay her $100,000 American Express bill. Guilfoyle posted a statement on social media saying the allegations were false and that she intends to vigorously defend her name, reputation, and integrity. Meanwhile, the new press secretary is getting mixed reviews.
title: New White House Press Secretary Says Kimberly Guilfoyle Was Asked To Resign

author: Inside Edition
description: High School sophomore Lilly Bova was enjoying spring break in Chicago's family-friendly suburb, Glenview, when on a Saturday morning she died after being shot in her own bed. Her mom, Christie Maga, says her daughter was murdered, and claims she knows who did it. But nearly seven months later, no one has been charged.
title: Mother Says Her Daughter Was Murdered, And Claims She Knows Who Did It

author: Inside Edition
description: A U.S. Coast Guard team in Florida has saved a distressed sea turtle caught by its neck in a crab pot line. The crew was headed back to Coast Guard Station Cortez on Sunday when members spotted the trapped, struggling turtle. After pulling the marine reptile alongside their boat, members were able to rescue it by untangling the line, freeing the turtle to swim safely away.
title: Coast Guard Rescues Sea Turtle Tangled In Crab Pot Line

author: Inside Edition
description: An officer rushes to help a man trapped in a car sinking into a lake. It happened in Cato, New York on Cross Lake. The state police say an officer jumped into the water and used a window punch device to break through the sunroof of the vehicle. That allowed the driver to escape. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Trooper Jumps Into Water To Save Man From Sinking Vehicle

description: The International Cryptozoology Museum in Bangor, Maine features dozens of casts of 'Bigfoot' footprints. Are any of them real?
title: Why Do People Think They See Bigfoot? #shorts
